text: Stewie! My AI assistant just wrote four hundred lines of code for a simple date picker!
Because you are letting it drown in boilerplate! You need Ponytail—the lazy senior dev plugin!
Lazy?! Why would I ever want a lazy developer?!
Because lazy means efficient! He says nothing, writes one line, and slashes AI code by fifty-three percent!
Holy crap! It replaced a three-hundred-line calendar package with ten lines of HTML?!
Precisely! And ninety-eight percent of risky logic ships with tests across twenty AI agents!
Sweet! An AI tool that works as little as I do! Where do I get it?!
Search DietrichGebert slash ponytail on GitHub and stop burning your API tokens, you fool!
